meta.title: Bundled PGS Catalog scoring files
meta.description: Real, unmodified polygenic score files from the PGS Catalog (https://www.pgscatalog.org). Each file keeps its published #key=value header, citation and weights exactly as distributed. Scores are matched to your genotype by rsID, which is genome-build independent.
meta.source: PGS Catalog (Lambert et al., Nature Genetics 2021 & 2024). Individual score citations are inside each file header and shown per card.
meta.note: Weight types differ across scores (beta, log(OR), odds ratios). The relative-position bar shows where your dosage-weighted total sits between the minimum and maximum attainable for the variants present in your file. It is NOT a percentile, probability, or calibrated risk, and is NOT adjusted for ancestry.
